knowledge_base.title: Reduce water usage during bathing
knowledge_base.content: Reducing bathing time and avoiding unnecessary running water can help households conserve water.
actions: Keep bathing time short.
Turn off the tap when water is not needed.
Use a bucket where practical instead of a long shower.

knowledge_base.title: Prevent tap leakage
knowledge_base.content: A leaking tap can waste water continuously. Regular inspection and timely repair can reduce unnecessary water loss.
actions: Check taps for continuous dripping.
Repair or replace damaged washers.
Contact a plumber if the leakage continues.

knowledge_base.title: Use water-efficient appliances
knowledge_base.content: Using appliances efficiently can reduce household water consumption.
actions: Run the washing machine with a suitable full load.
Choose water-efficient appliances when replacement is needed.
Avoid unnecessary repeated washing cycles.

knowledge_base.title: Reuse suitable household water
knowledge_base.content: Some lightly used water, such as suitable leftover water from washing vegetables, may be reused for non-drinking purposes.
actions: Reuse suitable vegetable-washing water for plants.
Use collected rainwater for gardening where practical.
Never reuse contaminated water for drinking or cooking.

knowledge_base.title: Investigate high water loss
knowledge_base.content: A high difference between supplied and consumed water may indicate leakage, meter problems, or measurement errors. Further investigation is required before confirming the cause.
actions: Inspect pipelines and visible joints.
Verify inlet and outlet meter readings.
Compare readings with historical records.
Record inspection findings.

knowledge_base.title: Investigate low water pressure
knowledge_base.content: Unusually low pressure may be associated with leakage, pump issues, blockage, or sensor problems. The cause should be verified through inspection.
actions: Check pressure sensor readings.
Inspect pumps and pipeline connections.
Compare pressure with normal operating conditions.

knowledge_base.title: Verify unusual flow differences
knowledge_base.content: An unusual difference between inlet and outlet flow readings may indicate water loss or measurement problems.
actions: Verify inlet and outlet meter readings.
Check sensors for incorrect measurements.
Investigate the pipeline if unusual readings continue.

knowledge_base.title: Handle missing or invalid readings
knowledge_base.content: Missing, negative, or inconsistent readings can affect anomaly detection. Invalid records should be reviewed before making decisions.
actions: Check missing and invalid readings.
Verify sensor and meter records.
Do not treat incomplete data as confirmed leakage.
